title: A Message To All Leaders
text: we need leaders who are not afraid to mentor it is my hope that out of this conference this week shall emerge great women and men who have a different concept of leadership greatness it's my hope that you will set a standard for your organization for your company for your city for your government for your business church where you will be happy and joyful to move on to the next leg you know what I like about it relay you run hard but you ain't got to run long not only like about a marathon hidden is great just to say I used to run that department look at it now the crepe Department is I trained her I used to be the president of company over there see there yeah I helped build that what a beautiful thing when you win a relay the person that brings the pattern across the tape is not the one who gets the prize all four of them stand up on that box on the same level get the same metal this is great leadership [Applause]
